draft.text: You came in to talk about a foot ulcer on the top of your right foot near your fifth toe.
You mentioned it has yellow discharge and more drainage than before.
We found that you have not had any tests to check blood flow to your feet.
You also said you have not had a wound culture done to check for infection.
Your foot ulcer is not healing and may be infected.
You have type 2 diabetes with high blood sugar levels, which can affect healing.
A wound culture will be done to check for infection.
You will be referred for tests to check blood flow to your feet.
You will continue your current medications and improve foot care as advised.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have a foot ulcer on the top of your right foot, near your fifth toe.
It is about 1 inch in size and has yellow discharge and more drainage than before.
The ulcer is not painful, but you have been feeling more tired lately.
You have type 2 diabetes, and your blood sugar levels have been high, with an A1C of 10.
You are taking insulin and metformin.
You have a non-healing foot ulcer that may be infected.
You have not had any major infections or heart problems before.
You have not had any foot ulcers or infections in the past.
We will take a sample from the ulcer to check for infection.
We will refer you for tests to check the blood flow to your feet.
You should keep taking your current medications and take better care of your feet.
